title: [MTR4]Warsaw Metro Siemens Inspiro Train
description:
Warsaw Metro Siemens Inspiro Train
The Train cannot be 100% replicated due to my technical matters.
body:
Warsaw Metro Siemens Inspiro Train
**Only support 4-Doors(20blocks)length!**
Due to the lack of sufficient interior reference materials, I can only restore 80% of the interior despite my best efforts. As for the front carriage, I have done everything possible, yet it is impossible to make it exactly identical to the real-world counterpart.

华沙地铁西门子Inspiro列车
**仅支持四门（20格）长度！**
由于內饰资料太少，即便我尽可能还原也只能还原內饰80%。而车头更是已经尽力，根本没法做到和现实里完全一样。
